subject: general
question: India developed its first indigenous Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) machine, set to be installed at __________.

options.text: All Indian Institute of Medical Sciences, Nagpur
All Indian Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhopal
All Indian Institute of Medical Sciences, Raipur
All Indian Institute of Medical Sciences, Delhi

solution:
The correct answer is __**All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India’s first **indigenous Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) machine** was developed with advanced technology, showcasing India’s capability in **medical equipment innovation.**
 
• The machine is set to be installed at **All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Delhi**, which is one of the premier medical institutions in India.
 
• AIIMS Delhi is renowned for its **world-class healthcare services**, **research**, and **medical education**, making it an ideal location for such a significant technological addition.
 
• This indigenous MRI machine signifies a major step forward in reducing dependency on **foreign imports** and promoting **‘Make in India’** initiatives in healthcare technology.
 
• MRI machines are essential diagnostic tools used to produce detailed images of the **internal structures of the body**, aiding in the diagnosis of various diseases and conditions.
 
• The development and installation of this machine highlight India’s capability to advance in **medical science** and enhance healthcare infrastructure.
 
• AIIMS Delhi’s integration of this machine will likely benefit both patients and medical practitioners by providing **cost-effective and efficient diagnostic solutions.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **All Indian Institute of Medical Sciences, Nagpur**__

 __
 
• **AIIMS Nagpur** is one of the newer AIIMS institutions established under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY).
 
• It is located in **Nagpur, Maharashtra**, and provides healthcare services and education to the central region of India.
 
 
 
• **All Indian Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhopal**__
 __
 
• **AIIMS Bhopal** is situated in **Madhya Pradesh** and plays a vital role in delivering healthcare services and medical education in the central part of India.
 
• It is an important institution established to enhance medical education and healthcare facilities under the PMSSY.
 
 
 
• **All Indian Institute of Medical Sciences, Raipur**__
 
 
• **AIIMS Raipur** is located in **Chhattisgarh** and contributes significantly to healthcare and medical research in the region.
 
• It is one of the AIIMS institutions set up to improve medical infrastructure in underserved areas.
